title: 2019-20 Panini Donruss Optic Rated Rookie Pink Hyper Prizm #174 Justin Robinson
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2019-20 Panini Donruss Optic Rated Rookie Pink Hyper Prizm #174 sports trading card featuring Justin Robinson of the Washington Wizards from the National Basketball Association (NBA). The card is part of the base set and features a parallel/variety design. 

The card is not autographed but is perfect for any basketball collector or fan. This card is from the 2019-20 season and manufactured by Panini. It includes various features like rookie status, parallel/variety design, and card number. It's a must-have for any serious basketball card collector or fan of the Washington Wizards.
